For each question, choose the correct answer.
Cyclist Vicky Harmiston
Reporter Mark Lewis writes about Vicky Harmiston, who has had a successful career as a track cyclist - a cyclist who races on special race tracks.
When Vicky Harmiston was a child, her parents gave her and her brother Jamie the freedom to decide what they did in their spare time. Vicky chose to do lots of different sports. She was a good swimmer, and the coach at the swimming club she went to thought she might be good enough to become a champion. But the club was a long way from her home so it was difficult for her to fit in the training around her schoolwork. When they were teenagers, Jamie, who loved cycling, bought himself a special track-racing bike and started taking part in competitions. Vicky thought it looked very exciting and decided to try it for herself. She says that was the best decision she ever made. Soon she was cycling every day and doing really well. The track was near her school, which meant it was no problem for her to attend training sessions after school every day.
Vicky went on to have a successful career in track cycling and won several competitions. Then, when she was 28, she retired from competitive cycling. Vicky told me: 'For years I'd loved winning competitions but I began to get a bit tired of the whole thing - and when the excitement stops, there's no point. Luckily, I went on to have a new career.'
Vicky got a job with a charity called CycleZone. "We work with young people who have never enjoyed sport,' she says. The first thing we do is teach them to ride a bike. We want them to learn to believe in themselves and their own abilities. CycleZone does a great job, and it gets young people together so they're part of a wider group.
The charity uses celebrities to advertise the work they do. Vicky says, 'I know some people aren't sure whether the support of a celebrity is always positive for a charity. They say the celebrities are only doing it to push themselves forward, which prevents the public from seeing the real work of the charity. But if famous singers and actors, for example, can help, I think they should."
When Vicky first started cycling, she ______.
A. had a very good coach.
B. her parents gave her helpful advice.
C. she could get to a race track easily.
D. her brother gave her a great bike.
Why does Vicky say she stopped cycle racing?
A. She felt she was too old to do it.
B. She was becoming bored with it.
C. She had won everything she wanted.
D. She was preparing for a new career.
What does the charity CycleZone do for young people?
A. It teaches them how to do track racing.
B. It supports those who have talent.
C. It offers them the chance to try a variety of sports.
D. It helps them become more confident.
According to Vicky, some people believe that celebrities can ______.
A. take attention away from what a charity does.
B. help people understand a charity's work.
C. make the public care less about a charity.
D. encourage more people to become involved with a charity.
What would Vicky say on her blog?
A. As a child, I always knew what I wanted to do when I grew up. But I never expected to become so famous.
B. If you join CycleZone, you'll get to meet celebrities and learn how they've become successful.
C. Although track cycling is not the only sport I've been good at, I've never regretted my choice of career.
D. In my spare time I love going to schools and helping groups of children learn to ride bikes.

questions.explanation: 题目问 Vicky 刚开始骑自行车时的情况。原文提到 “The track was near her school, which meant it was no problem for her to attend training sessions”（赛道离学校近，方便课后训练），对应 C 选项 “她能轻松到达赛道”。A 选项 “有好教练” 和 B 选项 “父母给建议” 未提及；D 选项 “哥哥给了很棒的自行车” 错误，是哥哥自己买了车，Vicky 后来尝试。

questions.text: Why does Vicky say she stopped cycle racing?

options.label: A
options.text: She felt she was too old to do it.

options.label: B
options.text: She was becoming bored with it.

options.label: C
options.text: She had won everything she wanted.

options.label: D
options.text: She was preparing for a new career.

questions.explanation: Vicky 停止比赛的原因是 “began to get a bit tired of the whole thing - and when the excitement stops, there's no point”（对比赛失去兴趣，兴奋感消失），对应 B 选项 “她变得厌倦”。A 选项 “年龄太大”、C 选项 “赢得所有想赢的”、D 选项 “准备新职业” 均与原文不符。

questions.text: What does the charity CycleZone do for young people?

options.label: A
options.text: It teaches them how to do track racing.

options.label: B
options.text: It supports those who have talent.

options.label: C
options.text: It offers them the chance to try a variety of sports.

options.label: D
options.text: It helps them become more confident.

questions.explanation: CycleZone 的作用是 “want them to learn to believe in themselves and their own abilities”（帮助年轻人建立自信），对应 D 选项 “帮助他们更自信”。A 选项 “教赛道骑行”、B 选项 “支持有天赋的人”、C 选项 “提供尝试多种运动的机会” 均与原文 “教骑车、建立自信” 不符。

questions.text: According to Vicky, some people believe that celebrities can ______.

options.label: A
options.text: take attention away from what a charity does.

options.label: B
options.text: help people understand a charity's work.

options.label: C
options.text: make the public care less about a charity.

options.label: D
options.text: encourage more people to become involved with a charity.

questions.explanation: 有些人认为名人代言会 “prevents the public from seeing the real work of the charity”（让公众忽视慈善机构的真正工作），对应 A 选项 “转移对慈善工作的关注”。B 选项 “帮助理解慈善工作”、C 选项 “让公众更少关心慈善”、D 选项 “鼓励更多人参与” 与原文相反或无关。

questions.text: What would Vicky say on her blog?

options.label: A
options.text: As a child, I always knew what I wanted to do when I grew up. But I never expected to become so famous.

options.label: B
options.text: If you join CycleZone, you'll get to meet celebrities and learn how they've become successful.

options.label: C
options.text: Although track cycling is not the only sport I've been good at, I've never regretted my choice of career.

options.label: D
options.text: In my spare time I love going to schools and helping groups of children learn to ride bikes.

questions.explanation: C 选项 “虽然赛道骑行不是我唯一擅长的运动，但从未后悔职业选择” 与原文 “she says that was the best decision she ever made”（认为开始骑行是最佳决定）一致。A 选项 “小时候就知道想做什么” 与原文 “尝试多种运动后选择骑行” 矛盾；B 选项 “加入 CycleZone 能见到名人” 原文未提及；D 选项 “业余时间去学校教孩子骑车” 与原文 “在 CycleZone 工作” 不符。
